# Crown Masters Adventures

> Corporate team building company based in Parklands, Nairobi, Kenya. Plans and facilitates team building events, books 123 team building venues across Kenya, Tanzania and Uganda, runs on-site corporate fitness programmes, and arranges group transport.

## Contact
- Office: Park Place, 2nd Avenue, Parklands, Nairobi, Kenya
- Phone and WhatsApp: +254 706 494 806
- Email: teambuilding@crownmastersadventures.co.ke
- Quote form: https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/contact-us/

## Services
- [Corporate team building](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/team-building/): facilitated events for teams of all sizes, with venue, transport and meals arranged
- [Indoor team building](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/team-building/indoor/): problem-solving and communication challenges in a hall or boardroom
- [Outdoor and adventure](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/team-building/outdoor-adventure/): obstacle courses, treasure hunts, rafting at Sagana, cycling at Hell's Gate
- [Transport and logistics](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/team-building/transport-logistics/): executive transport hire for groups
- [Corporate fitness](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/corporate-fitness/): Zumba, aerobics, calisthenics, HIIT, interval and circuit training at clients' offices, with fitness tests and nutrition guidance

## Venue regions
- [Nairobi, Kiambu, Machakos & Kajiado](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/nairobi-kiambu-machakos-kajiado/): 28 venues, gardens and city hotels, 30 minutes to 2 hours by road from Nairobi. Best for: One-day events, large groups on a tight schedule, and teams that need to be back the same evening.
- [Naivasha, Nakuru & Elementaita](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/naivasha-nakuru-elementaita/): 23 venues, lakeside resorts, about 1.5 to 3 hours by road from Nairobi. Best for: Overnight retreats, year-end trips and groups that want activities mixed with downtime.
- [Murang'a, Sagana, Nyeri & Nyahururu](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/muranga-sagana-nyeri-nyahururu/): 14 venues, river and adventure camps, about 1.5 to 3 hours by road from Nairobi. Best for: Adventure-focused teams, younger groups and anyone who wants rafting or camping on the programme.
- [Nanyuki & Isiolo](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/nanyuki-isiolo/): 9 venues, highland lodges, about 3 to 4 hours by road from Nairobi. Best for: Leadership and executive retreats, strategy sessions and smaller groups wanting a quieter setting.
- [Mombasa & North Coast](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/mombasa-north-coast/): 11 venues, beach hotels, about 1 hour by air or 5 hours by SGR train from Nairobi. Best for: Incentive and reward trips, conferences combined with team activities, and multi-day getaways.
- [Diani & South Coast](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/diani-south-coast/): 8 venues, beach hotels, about 1 hour by air to Ukunda, or SGR plus road transfer from Nairobi. Best for: Longer getaways and reward trips where rest is part of the purpose.
- [Kisumu, Eldoret & Western](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/kisumu-eldoret-western/): 9 venues, lake and city hotels, about 1 hour by air from Nairobi from Nairobi. Best for: Teams based in the west, regional offices and lakeside events.
- [Baringo & Bogoria](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/baringo-bogoria/): 2 venues, remote lake camps, about 5 hours by road from Nairobi. Best for: Small teams, adventurous groups and repeat clients looking for a new destination.
- [Tanzania & Zanzibar](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/tanzania-zanzibar/): 12 venues, cross-border resorts, by air, or by road to Arusha from Nairobi. Best for: Regional East African teams and international reward trips.
- [Uganda](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/venues/uganda/): 7 venues, cross-border resorts, by air to Entebbe from Nairobi. Best for: Regional teams with Ugandan offices and international retreats.

- [Team building near Nairobi: day trip or overnight?](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/blog/team-building-venues-near-nairobi/): How travel time, budget and goals decide between a one-day event and a retreat.
- [What goes into a team building budget in Kenya](https://crownmastersadventures.co.ke/blog/team-building-budget-kenya/): Every cost line explained, so your quote holds no surprises.
